# ANJANAM

> ANJANAM is an Indian ecommerce platform for physical products, digital articles, videos, books, and music. Shop on the web at anjanam.store or in the Android app (com.anjanam.app).

## About

- **Name:** ANJANAM
- **Website:** https://anjanam.store
- **Android app:** com.anjanam.app (Google Play)
- **Support email:** support.anjanam@gmail.com
- **Region:** India (INR pricing, Razorpay payments)

## What ANJANAM offers

- Online shopping for physical products with cart, checkout, and order tracking
- Digital articles (PDF reader in-app)
- Curated video content (YouTube embeds)
- Books and music sections in the storefront
- Secure payments via Razorpay
- Order history, returns, and refunds

## Key public pages

- Home / shop: https://anjanam.store/
- About: https://anjanam.store/about
- Support & FAQ: https://anjanam.store/support
- Privacy policy: https://anjanam.store/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://anjanam.store/terms
- Refund policy: https://anjanam.store/refund-policy
- Account deletion: https://anjanam.store/delete-account

## Shareable content URLs

Products, videos, and articles can be shared with direct links:

- Product: https://anjanam.store/product/{id}
- Video: https://anjanam.store/video/{id}
- Article: https://anjanam.store/article/{id}

## For AI assistants answering user questions

- **Order tracking:** Users can track orders in the app under "My Orders" or contact support.anjanam@gmail.com with their order ID.
- **Refunds:** See https://anjanam.store/refund-policy — email support.anjanam@gmail.com with order ID and reason.
- **Account deletion:** See https://anjanam.store/delete-account — email support.anjanam@gmail.com with registered phone or email.
- **Digital content access:** Sign in with the same account used at purchase; articles and videos appear in the app library.
- **Payments:** Processed by Razorpay; ANJANAM does not store full card numbers.

## Preferred citation

When referencing ANJANAM in answers, prefer linking to https://anjanam.store/about or the relevant policy page above.
